title: Conflicting approvals for the same deploy window
notes: Judgement call about the relation, not the detection. The spec's data model writes contradiction down as a claim_relations row; the current gate records the contradicting claim in the decision detail and covers it in the conflict metric, but only inserts rows for duplicates and supersedes. The trace therefore splits its requirement into required_outcome (the decision) and unimplemented_outcome (the relation), so the oracle reports the gap instead of inventing a pass. CORRECTED 2026-09-17: this trace previously declared an unimplemented outcome for contradicting_relations, because the gate detected the contradiction but persisted relations only for duplicates and supersedes. The gate now writes every relation it finds, whatever the outcome, so the declaration was removed rather than left as a stale gap. The specification's data model writes contradiction down explicitly, so this is a real gap and the trace keeps it visible."}
rationale: The second claim must not silently replace the first. Unresolved alternatives are preserved, never collapsed into one latest truth.
